constraints.meaning: Up to 100,000 elements. The window length k is at least 1 and never longer than the array.
constraints.impact: Summing every window from scratch is O(n·k), up to about 10¹⁰ steps when k is near n/2: too slow. You need O(n). There is always at least one full window, so the answer always exists.

constraints.meaning: Values can be negative, zero or positive.
constraints.impact: The best sum can be negative, so do not start largest at 0: start it at the sum of the first window. A window sum is at most 10⁵ × 10⁴ = 10⁹ in size, so int is enough.

constraints.text: Any answer with a calculation error less than 10⁻⁵ will be accepted (statement)
constraints.meaning: The answer is a double, and small rounding differences are fine.
constraints.impact: All windows have the same length k, so the largest average belongs to the largest sum. Keep integer sums and divide by k only once, at the end.

bruteForce.summary: for every start i, add up nums[i..i+k-1] from scratch and keep the largest sum. O(n·k) time, which is too slow when n = 10⁵ and k is large.
